SELECT TRUNC(DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE(1000000000000, 9999999999999)) FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO T_REVENUE_CONTRACT ( CONTRACT_ID, CONTRACT_NO, CONTRACT_NAME, CUSTOMER_ID, CONTRACT_AMOUNT, CONTRACT_STATUS, SIGN_DATE, EFFECTIVE_DATE, EXPIRY_DATE, PERFORMANCE_OBLIGATIONS, RECOGNITION_METHOD, CONTRACT_DESC, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, VERSION, IS_DELETED, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATOR, UPDATER ) VALUES ( #{contractId}, #{contractNo}, #{contractName}, #{customerId}, #{contractAmount}, #{contractStatus}, #{signDate}, #{effectiveDate}, #{expiryDate}, #{performanceObligations}, #{recognitionMethod}, #{contractDesc}, #{bookId}, #{tenantId}, #{version}, #{isDeleted}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{creator}, #{updater} )
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID), 0) as diversityScore, NVL(AVG(CASE WHEN CONTRACT_STATUS = 2 THEN 90 ELSE 70 END), 0) as timelinessScore, NVL(AVG(CONTRACT_AMOUNT), 0) as sustainability, NVL(COUNT(*), 0) as stability, NVL(COUNT(*) * 10, 0) as predictability, '中等' as riskLevel FROM T_REVENUE_CONTRACT WHERE IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT TO_CHAR(SIGN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') as period, SUM(CONTRACT_AMOUNT) as amount FROM T_REVENUE_CONTRACT WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND SIGN_DATE >= ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE, -#{months}) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(SIGN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY period DESC
